title: Panduratin A from Boesenbergia rotunda Effectively Inhibits EGFR/STAT3/Akt Signaling Pathways, Inducing Apoptosis in NSCLC Cells with Wild-Type and T790M Mutations in EGFR.
authors: Eiamart, Wanna; Wonganan, Piyanuch; Tadtong, Sarin; Samee, Weerasak
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Panduratin A对EGFR突变肺癌细胞的凋亡诱导作用，涉及蛋白-小分子对接，但对象为蛋白-药物互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) is a challenging disease, with the epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) being a key target for new, effective treatments crucial for the signaling pathways regulating cancer cell survival. Targeting EGFR-mediated signaling offers promising strategies to improve NSCLC therapies, particularly in overcoming resistance in EGFR-mutant lung cancer. In this study, we investigated the anticancer effects of panduratin A, a naturally occurring flavonoid from Boesenbergia rotunda, on human NSCLC cell lines expressing both wild-type EGFR (A549) and mutant EGFR (H1975) using in vitro experiments and molecular docking approaches. Cytotoxicity screening revealed that panduratin A exhibits potent effects on both A549 (IC(50) of 6.03 +/- 0.21 microg/mL) and H1975 (IC(50) of 5.58 +/- 0.15 microg/mL) cell lines while demonstrating low toxicity to normal MRC5 lung cells (12.96 +/- 0.36 microg/mL). Furthermore, western blotting and flow cytometric analyses indicated that panduratin A induces apoptosis by inhibiting p-EGFR and its downstream effectors, p-STAT3 and p-Akt, in lung cancer cells. Additionally, the docking study showed lower binding energy between panduratin A and the target proteins, comparable to that of epidermal growth factor receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors (EGFR TKIs). The ADMET prediction also highlighted panduratin A's exceptional drug-like properties. This study concludes that panduratin A shows significant promise as an anti-lung cancer candidate for NSCLC, offering an economical and effective strategy.
abstract_zh: 非小细胞肺癌（NSCLC）是一种具有挑战性的疾病，其中表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）是调控癌细胞存活信号通路的关键靶点，对于开发新的有效治疗方法至关重要。靶向EGFR介导的信号传导为改善NSCLC治疗提供了有前景的策略，尤其是在克服EGFR突变型肺癌的耐药性方面。在本研究中，我们通过体外实验和分子对接方法，探讨了来自姜黄（Boesenbergia rotunda）的天然类黄酮化合物panduratin A对表达野生型EGFR（A549）和突变型EGFR（H1975）的人非小细胞肺癌细胞系的抗癌作用。细胞毒性筛选显示，panduratin A对A549（IC(50)为6.03 ± 0.21微克/毫升）和H1975（IC(50)为5.58 ± 0.15微克/毫升）细胞系均表现出强效作用，同时对正常MRC5肺细胞显示出低毒性（12.96 ± 0.36微克/毫升）。此外，蛋白质印迹和流式细胞术分析表明，panduratin A通过抑制p-EGFR及其下游效应因子p-STAT3和p-Akt在肺癌细胞中诱导凋亡。另外，对接研究显示panduratin A与靶蛋白之间的结合能较低，与表皮生长因子受体酪氨酸激酶抑制剂（EGFR TKIs）相当。ADMET预测也突显了panduratin A优异的药物样特性。本研究得出结论，panduratin A作为NSCLC的抗肺癌候选药物显示出显著潜力，提供了一种经济有效的策略。
